metadata.description: Internal Claude Code plugins for OhMyHotel engineering — git workflow, PR automation, release management following the company Git Branch Strategy.

plugins.name: omh-git-workflow
plugins.description: 21 slash commands that automate the OMH git branch strategy: new-branch, new-worktree, commit, squash, open-pr, open-pr-to, check-pr, fix-pr, ci-status, reviewers, release, cherry-pick, reset-develop, reset-staging, sync-local, sync-master, hotfix, rollback, delete-branch, clean-worktree, status.
